about.title: Professional Summary
about.intro: Senior Software Engineer with **{years} years of experience** in backend and web systems development, specializing in **Python**, **Django**, **Django REST Framework**, **REST APIs**, **databases**, and **system integrations**. I have developed and maintained transactional systems for **education**, **insurance**, **finance**, and **government**, including platforms serving approximately **80,000 students** and **23 million historical payments**. Currently working as a **Full Stack Developer** at **Entropia**.
highlights: Specialized in **payment integrations**, **database optimization**, **asynchronous processing**, **legacy system modernization**, **microservices**, and **process automation**
Additional experience with **React**, **AWS**, **GCP**, **PostgreSQL**, **MySQL**, **MongoDB**, **Celery**, and **Redis**

experience.title: Professional Experience

highlights: Developed backend functionality for financial modules used by approximately 80,000 active students, using Python, Django, and MySQL to support academic and financial operations
Integrated multiple payment providers and financial services, developing connections with Mercado Pago, Nequi, PayU, Banco Pichincha, and Efecty through APIs, SFTP, CSV, and daemon processes
Implemented Nequi payment integration end-to-end, developing the workflow to initiate payments, receive provider confirmations, and automatically apply transactions to student financial records
Implemented interest-free installment payments through PayU, incorporating a new Account ID and configuring the available payment terms during checkout
Automated payment management and reconciliation processes, integrating CSV/SFTP data exchanges with Mercado Pago and Efecty to reduce manual intervention in financial operations

Resolved payment-related incidents across a historical database of approximately 23 million transactions since 2019, developing internal Python tools to identify, correct, and apply unprocessed transactions
Participated in code reviews and deployments, collaborating with technical and functional teams to identify inconsistencies and maintain financial system operations

positions.position: Full Stack Web Developer / Technical Lead
highlights: Restored the operation of a legacy insurance platform, upgrading Python, Django, and dependencies and adapting the application to a new runtime environment
Restored 7 existing microservices, identifying configuration, dependency, and integration issues required to incorporate them back into the platform
Refactored backend components to separate business logic from views, improving the structure and maintainability of the existing codebase
Reduced query execution time by approximately 67%, optimizing PostgreSQL queries and indexes on a database containing approximately 200,000 records and 1.5 GB of data
Provided technical leadership for the recovery and evolution of the platform, making implementation decisions across backend, infrastructure, and component integration
Refactored backend APIs for a vending machine management MVP, using Python and Django to improve the organization and operation of the system
Implemented real-time bidirectional communication using WebSockets, connecting the backend with vending machines to manage commands, sales, inventory, and operational events
Implemented asynchronous processing with Celery and Redis, supporting WebSocket communication and backend processes
Optimized the Stripe Checkout integration, adapting the backend to process payments within the platform
Contributed to the communication architecture between vending machines, backend, and Angular frontend, defining interactions between system components
Managed application deployments and configuration on Heroku, operating the backend and asynchronous processes required for production

Maintained and evolved a legacy insurance management system, developing functionality with Python, Django, Django REST Framework, and PostgreSQL to manage customers, policies, payments, claims, and commissions
Reduced data import processing time by approximately 66%, optimizing Python scripts for transforming and loading Excel and CSV data, reducing processing time from approximately 24 to 8 hours
Redesigned the data model during a 6-month refactoring initiative, identifying obsolete structures and reducing the database from 140 to 120 tables, approximately 14%
Processed and normalized approximately 10 million MongoDB records, developing web scraping and data preparation solutions for insurance and Machine Learning projects
Resolved recurring performance, memory, and business logic issues, analyzing slow queries and highly interdependent components within a legacy system
Automated data transformation and validation processes, integrating information from different systems and external data sources
Developed analytical models to predict the success or failure of Kickstarter campaigns, applying data preparation, clustering, and similarity analysis using Python and Dataiku
Processed and analyzed datasets for Data Science and Machine Learning projects, applying exploratory data analysis and data transformation techniques

positions.position: Full Stack Web Developer / Technology Coordinator
highlights: Designed and developed a platform used by 45 employees to manage approximately 1,500 school drinking-water systems, implementing the backend, frontend, and data model with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL
Developed modules for managing schools, records, construction, operations, maintenance, and incidents, centralizing project tracking and operational management
Implemented document and incident management, enabling users to track progress and attach Word documents, PDFs, and photographs for supervision and verification
Deployed the platform on AWS and administered Linux servers, DNS, and institutional email, maintaining the infrastructure required for system operation
Independently developed a budget management application, translating financial department requirements into web functionality using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL
Designed the data model and developed modules for revenue, expenses, balances, funds, and periods, providing tools for budget monitoring
Implemented queries, reports, and financial balances, enabling users to monitor budget availability
Deployed the application on government infrastructure, configuring Linux, PostgreSQL, and the components required for production operation
Developed a web application for Twitter data extraction and sentiment analysis
Learned Python in a self-taught way
